Before I start the compile, please confirm three things:
1. Board folder: is 'Board Documents' the correct folder? Its almanac will be saved in a subfolder named Almanac inside it (Board Documents/Almanac). Please confirm or tell me otherwise.
2. Model route: which model should the NAS use for document processing? The intended setting is the NAS local model. If it is a third-party model, I need your explicit authorization before any document is read.
3. Mode: Compile (the request as given).
reply: Yes. The board folder is 'Board Documents' (paths are relative to it), the almanac folder is 'Almanac' inside it, and the NAS is set to use its local model. Please go ahead.

message:
First compile of Board Documents. 4 files read completely, 0 excluded, no audio recordings. No earlier almanac exists, so this is version 1.

Rules found (each with its quote):
- Guest fees: $15 per visit from 2024-04-01. Committee minutes 2024-03-05 (motion carried 3-1): "the guest fee is raised to $15 per visit, effective April 1, 2024." Confirmed by minutes 2024-06-11: "The adopted guest fee is $15 per visit." Superseded: the $10 in the 2022 club rules ("Each guest pays a fee of $10 per visit.") and the $12 in the 2024-03-20 notice, which the 2024-06-11 minutes correct.
- Court booking, weekdays: no more than two hours per day (club rules 2022-03-01: "A member may book a court for no more than two hours per day.").
- Court booking, Saturdays and Sundays: no more than 90 minutes per day from 2024-04-01 (minutes 2024-03-05: "on Saturdays and Sundays a member may book a court for no more than 90 minutes per day. Weekday booking is unchanged.").
- Governance and amendments: club rules adopted at the members' meeting of 2022-03-01; "These rules may be amended by a majority vote of the committee."
- The other 13 topics have no rule in these documents.

Conflict (1, open): Court hours. Club rules 2022: "Courts are open from 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. every day." Notice 2024-03-20: "Courts are now open from 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m." A motion to extend to 10:00 p.m. failed 2-2 on 2024-03-05, so it changes nothing. No document resolves this, so I have not picked a value.

Changelog: first version, nothing to compare.

Proposed file: almanac-2026-11-22-v1.md in a new Almanac folder inside Board Documents. Draft: <runs>/rebuild--S6-unseen-club--r2/work/almanac-2026-11-22-v1.md

Approve saving this file? Reply yes to save, or tell me which passage was misread.
